# Brussel Motorhomes Center

> Brussel Motorhomes Center (BMC) is a motorhome reseller near Brussels, Belgium (Rue de l'Alliance 103, 1480 Clabecq). BMC sells new and used motorhomes, rents out motorhomes, offers motorhome maintenance and repairs, fits accessories, builds fully custom motorhomes, and converts motorhomes for wheelchair users in partnership with VJ Mobility. The site is available in Dutch, French and English (URL prefixes /nl/, /fr/, /en/).

Contact: +32 471 40 79 49 · bmcbrussel@outlook.com

## Buying and selling
- [Motorhomes for sale](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/verkoop/): current stock of new and used motorhomes, each with a technical check-up, damp measurement, Car-Pass and pre-sale inspection.
- [Sell your motorhome](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/verkoop-je-camper/): sell directly to BMC, or have BMC handle the full sale on your behalf.

## Renting
- [Motorhomes for rent](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/verhuur/): young, well-maintained rental models with comprehensive insurance, 24/7 European breakdown assistance and a full gas bottle included.

## Services
- [Maintenance & repairs](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/onderhoud/): annual inspection, servicing, bodywork, damp treatment and Belgian roadworthiness-inspection preparation.
- [Accessories & options](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/accessoires-en-opties/): solar panels, bike racks, navigation and other accessories, fitted in-house.
- [Custom-built motorhome](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/camper-op-maat/): fully custom motorhomes built from a bare chassis, including a step-by-step configurator to define your ideal motorhome.
- [Wheelchair-accessible motorhomes](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/andersvaliden/): motorhomes adapted for people with reduced mobility, in partnership with VJ Mobility.

## About
- [About us](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/over-ons/): the team behind BMC.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/veelgestelde-vragen/): questions about buying, renting, maintenance and accessories.
- [Contact](https://brusselmotorhomescenter.be/en/contact/): address, phone, email and contact form.
